svg.title: Tracking Monkey Typing: commits, lines, and tokens
svg.desc: Tracking Monkey Typing shows aggregate weekly commits and line movement, followed by anonymous Codex and Claude family token history on the same lifetime date domain when history is available. Code movement across the whole record at weekly grain. Totals: 5,463 commits, 27,555,643 additions, 24,790,382 deletions, and 154 active weeks. The commit axis uses log1p; the signed additions and deletions axis uses symmetric log. Rounded combined agent lifetime: 83.6B tokens, observed Aug 8, 2026. 100 completed-day family observations from Apr 30, 2026 through Aug 7, 2026. Dates before tracking began are unobserved, not zero. The token axis is linear from zero and shares the lifetime date domain used by the code plots. Multi-day observation gaps are dashed. Protected Codex account readings are aggregated before publication; Claude covers retained local usage; per-account readings and identities are not published. Provenance: automatic refresh. Exact family totals: Codex 77,883,282,128 tokens and Claude 5,753,705,069 tokens. Displayed shares are Codex 93.12% and Claude 6.88%. The neutral boundary traces their combined total. The approximate conversion is ~$65.7K using this site's current blended public API replay rate of 0.785974 dollars per million tokens as of 2026-07-12; it is not an actual bill.
svg.text: Lifetime code movement and recent Codex + Claude token history
